artworks.title: The First French Church in Berlin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows seven men from the knees up engaging in a formal or official setting. One man is sitting at a table, writing on a piece of paper, while the others are standing. They have similar curly hairstyles and wear detailed garments. The men appear focused, with some leaning forward. The seated figure also has curly hair and is dressed in an ornate coat. On the table are papers, a quill, and a decorative covering. The background features detailed paneling, with a view through an opening suggesting greenery or architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Fortunate Rescue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. Two of them are embracing in the foreground, kneeling on the ground and facing each other in a kiss. The person on the left has curly hair and appears to be wearing a coat-like garment, while the person on the right has long hair tied back and is dressed in a long robe. The third figure emerges from the bushes in the background, with shoulder-length hair, wearing a dress with a sash and a light shawl or scarf over their head. The setting includes tall trees, shrubs, and a structure with columns and arches on the right side, suggesting a garden or courtyard. Rolling hills and cloudy skies are in the distant background.

artworks.title: Imaginations
artworks.medium: etching (3 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts various fantastical and everyday elements in a series of illustrations on a single page. On the left, there are whimsical elements like a figure on stilts, people walking, and unusual caricatures. In the center, elegantly dressed figures are in a garden-like setting with trees. On the right, there are more peculiar drawings, including a massive rooster, a man beside a tree, and various small sketches of animals, birds, and human faces. The drawing has a light, sketched quality with playful and exaggerated elements.

artworks.title: Party with Six Ladies and the Artist
artworks.medium: etching and sulfur tint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows six individuals in varied seated and standing positions. The furthest left person is seated facing away from the viewer, looking at a table. Next to them, a person stands slightly bent forward wearing a cloak and a bonnet. In the center, three people are seated close together, two facing away and one facing towards the right with delicate facial features visible. In the foreground, a man with curly hair sits cross-legged on a bench, writing in a notebook. Another figure stands to the right looking downward. The setting appears to be indoors with simple furniture in the background.

artworks.title: Russians and Turks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three seated figures in historical or exotic attire, with additional background figures. The three figures are detailed with fine line work, each wearing distinct garments. One figure wears a hooded cloak, another has a cap and robe. There is a basket with birds or ducks near the first figure. In the background, smaller figures in robes can be seen. The drawing features shading and a carefully composed scene that suggests a cultural and historical setting.

artworks.title: Illustrations to La Fontaine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two distinct scenes. One shows an interior domestic scene with a person lying in a four-poster bed and another figure tending to them. The other scene depicts an outdoor gathering under a canopy of trees with figures dressed in period attire.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: Three full-body figures are depicted outside. The person on the left wears a long, dark robe and a hat with a broad brim. They face slightly towards the center. The central figure stands leaning back, dressed in a fitted suit with patterned pants and holding a wide-brimmed hat. The figure on the right has long hair tied back with a ribbon, wearing a long overcoat and holding a round hat behind them. The scene is set on a cobblestone street with trees, buildings, and a fence or wall in the background.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: Three people are depicted in the image. On the left, a person is handling a rolled document. This person has long hair, mostly hidden by a large hat, and is dressed in a gown. In the center, a woman stands with hands on her hips, wearing a full-length dress with a sash. She has short, curly hair and a necklace. The man on the right is turned slightly towards the woman, with his head bowed as if examining something up close. He has short, combed-back hair and is dressed in knee-length attire with a coat. He holds a lit candle in a candlestick, providing light in the room. The background shows a room with a grid pattern on the walls and ceiling. There is also a small object on the table near the man.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures interacting in a domestic setting. One woman is standing on the left side, holding a baby. She is leaning slightly towards the seated figures, focusing on the infant. The seated figures include another woman and a man, the man partly turned towards the women. Behind the man is a young child. The background shows a textured wall with a cloth, hanging textiles, and a piece of furniture on the right side. The floor is patterned tiles.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting on a bench in a wooded area. The person on the left is wearing a long coat and a tall hat, sitting with one leg crossed over the other and holding a cane. The individual on the right wears a cloak-like garment and a bonnet, pointing towards the distance. Their facial features are not distinctly visible due to the shading and the angle of view. The scene is surrounded by trees and foliage, creating a dense natural background. The sky is partly visible through the gaps in the trees.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals standing together within an interior setting. The woman in the middle is facing slightly to the right and is wearing a long dress with a cape, a bonnet, and a scarf wrapped around her neck. The man to her left is shown from the back, extending his hand towards her. He is dressed in a long coat, breeches, and stockings, holding a tricorne hat. The man opposite them is slightly bent forward, extending his hand towards the woman. He wears a similar long coat and breeches. In the background, a large staircase leads upward, and the area they occupy has a tiled floor.

artworks.title: The Voyage to Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: There is a drawing of an interior scene. The scene features a group of chairs and a framed image. The room is dimly lit, with tall-backed chairs on a tiled floor and framed pictures on the walls. There is a rectangular table or pedestal in the center. Light from an unseen source illuminates part of the room, possibly from a window. Fine lines and crosshatching are used for shading and texture, creating depth and perspective in the drawing.

artworks.title: Saint Nicolas of Myra
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, sand, green, olive, and tan, on blue paper, laid down on a leather book cover
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing. They hold a staff in their left hand and raise their right hand with two fingers extended. The person has facial features, short hair, and wears a robe with a large cloak over the shoulders. They wear an ornate headdress. Smaller figures to the left show reverence. The background has a simple patterned border.

artworks.title: American Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection) and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: The Booby (Pelecanus Sula)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird standing on a rock by the sea. The bird has dark brown plumage and webbed feet. The painting shows a high level of detail in the bird's feathers and beak. To the left is a faint outline of the bird's head. In the background, there is an expanse of water with a distant ship. The rock the bird is on is depicted with earthy tones. Text underneath the bird labels it as "The Booby" and provides a Latin description.

artworks.title: The Cutwater (Rhynchops nigra)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird in profile, standing on ground. The bird has distinct coloration, with dark plumage on its back, wings, and tail, and lighter color on its underbelly and face. It has long, slender legs with webbed feet, and an elongated, forked beak that is open. The beak shows a reddish-orange hue at the upper section and black tips. The drawing depicts detailed feathers, legs, and feet texture, with a minimal background.

artworks.title: Monsieur... voici ce que nous donnons... en prime...
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: Two men and a child are depicted in the image. One man gestures towards a pile of papers and books, with an open mouth. The other man wears a tall hat and stands with his back to the viewer. The child, wearing a cap and dark clothing, points upwards towards the pile. The background contains a bookcase full of items, including musical instruments, books, and loose pages. The wall displays the text "L'UNIVERS MUSICAL."

artworks.title: Les troupes Austro-Prussiennes entrant a Hambourg ... [top half]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jan Rie Kist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring military troops and a crowd near a coastline. The illustration depicts a large group of mounted troops moving, with a large tower structure on the left and dockside posts to the right. The scene is busy, with many individuals on foot interacting. Children and adults are present, observing and accompanying the mounted figures, adding to the dynamic energy of the scene. The drawing has detailed line work typical of 19th-century illustrated periodicals, capturing the social and historical context of a military event with depth.

artworks.title: Interieur d'un omnibus [bottom half]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jan Rie Kist
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals seated in an enclosed vehicle, likely an omnibus. Most of the people are visible from the waist up, except for the standing individual on the left. This person stands to the side, holding onto a vertical pole. To their right, a seated woman cradles a baby. Next to them sits a man with a stocky build, followed by a woman with a distinctive profile. The final man in the lineup wears a tall top hat and appears to be leaning with eyes closed. They are dressed in 19th-century attire. The background features minimal details of window frames or panels, suggesting they are inside a transportation vehicle.

artworks.title: Train de plaisir
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jan Rie Kist
artworks.description: The image shows four people seated closely together, visible from the chest up, in an enclosed carriage or compartment. They are positioned side by side, facing forward, and huddled closely. The first person on the left has their head slightly tilted down with features partially obscured by a headscarf and coat. The second person has a solemn expression, with prominent facial lines, wearing a high top hat, and a thick, high-collared coat. The third person is wearing a hat with a slightly frilled edge, has drooping facial features, and is draped in thick clothing. The fourth person on the right, like the second, wears a top hat and has their face partially covered by a scarf or coat collar. All individuals seem wrapped in heavy garments and bundled blankets. The background depicts a texture resembling paneling or a wooden wall, with a bright area in the upper right, possibly representing a window letting in light or showing the exterior environment.

artworks.title: Woodland Pond with a Fisherman
artworks.medium: black chalk with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image features a detailed landscape drawing from a slightly elevated point of view showcasing a natural scene filled with dense woodland. The horizon is not distinctly demarcated, suggesting the presence of distant tree lines blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are intricate, utilizing fine lines and hatching to convey texture in the foliage and trees, and to define the landscape's elements. The color palette is primarily composed of monochromatic earthy tones, with shades of tan and gray dominating the scene. Close to us, the scene is populated by detailed, large trees with swirling branches. Beyond these trees, the drawing continues to depict a rich forest environment, gradually becoming less distinct in the background. Hints of wildlife, like birds in flight, are present in the sky, adding movement to the setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sleeping Peasants
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a detailed tree in the center, hills, and distant trees in the background. The brush strokes give texture to the scene. The color scheme is primarily sepia. Near the bottom left, there is a bush and a round object. The landscape extends towards the horizon, where more trees are visible against the sky.

artworks.title: The Prison Visit
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of masked figures in a historical setting. The image shows an assembly of masked or costumed figures in an architectural environment featuring a staircase, brick walls, and a series of grid-like windows. The background includes arches and columns, with a texture suggesting a mix of stone and brickwork. The figures are engaged in various activities, some standing, gesturing, or interacting with each other, creating an air of festivity or mystery. The drawing uses sepia tones, contributing to an aged, classical effect reminiscent of sketches from a historical era.

artworks.title: Punchinello's Farewell to Venice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people near waterfront architecture. They are wearing long white robes and conical hats and appear to be engaged in conversation or celebration. There are gondolas, grand buildings, and a canal in the background. The scene includes a tile-patterned pavement and a dog observing from the side. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, known for dynamic compositions with architectural elements.
